Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of acute low back pain and stiffness.
Examination documented paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted lumbar range of motion, findings that fit well
with the mechanism and force of the impact. Imaging was obtained and clearly confirmed the soft tissue injury
consistent with a lumbar strain. The patient reported no prior injury to this body region, and no earlier treatment for
the area is known to this office.
Care was conservative and followed a typical course, including hands-on therapy, a home stretching program, and
as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. The patient attended four visits, with the frequency of visits and treatment
intensity tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward normal. Billing records reflect a single
charge for each visit, with no repeated or duplciate services. At the most recent visit the patient reported minimal
residual discomfort and was discharged to self-directed home exercise, with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
